messages:
incident-bot: Pager received: high error rate detected on api-gateway-prod (502/504 increase). Severity: P2. Paging Aisha (oncall) and eng-sre.
Aisha (oncall): seeing it, joining. +1 on pages. summary: spike in 502/504 from edge -> gateway, started ~10:02 UTC
Tom H: I'm looking at the dashboard now — 5xx rate jumped from 0.3% to 8% across eu-west and us-east.
Priya R: any customer-facing alerts yet?
Maya (support): Customers reporting "503" from internal apps. Support queue getting five duplicates in last 5m, flagged high priority customers.
Jorge (edge): rolling up logs from edge proxies. Initial signal: increased upstream timeouts to gateway pool g-prod-1, many 504s with downstream latency ~30s.
Aisha (oncall): can we switch routing to fallback region for critical routes? what's safe failover plan?
Tom H: can we confirm whether this is cause by gateway instances flapping or a backend saturation? checking gateway pod errors.
Priya R: I started a canary traffic shift for the critical /v1/generate route to dedicated-backend fallback (20% -> 50%)
deploy-bot: Canary shift initiated: route=/v1/generate weight->50% fallback=dedicated-backend at 10:07 UTC
Jorge (edge): edge logs show consistent 502 with body "upstream sent too few bytes" and 504 with "upstream request timeout". Tons of keepalive resets.
Tom H: grabbing gateway stack traces. seeing thread pool exhaustion on gateway workers, connections piling up: conn_wait_count spikes.
Aisha (oncall): runbook step: scale gateway pool g-prod-1 x2, enable circuit breaker for noisy upstreams. Who can push scaling?
Priya R: I can up replicas now. Scaling gateway g-prod-1 from 6 -> 12 replicas. ETA ~90s.
Priya R: scaling done (10:09 UTC). watching metrics.
Tom H: after scaling, 502 rate dropped 30%, but still elevated. Some 504s persist from a subset of backends (svc-embeddings-prod-2).
Jorge (edge): isolating problematic backend: svc-embeddings-prod-2 shows CPU pegged and GC spikes correlated with error window.
Maya (support): Notifying affected customers: sent short outage note to top 5 customers, advising retry and setting expectations. (template: "We're investigating increased 5xx errors impacting model endpoints in US/EU; mitigation in progress")
Aisha (oncall): good — include ETA note: ~15-30m. I'll coordinate postmortem ownership.
Tom H: applying temporary routing blacklist for svc-embeddings-prod-2 from gateway (traffic->0) while we bring it back under control.
Priya R: traffic blacklisted at 10:14 UTC. fallback route now handling that partition.
Jorge (edge): edge TTL for cached prefixes causing extra pressure removed. disabled aggressive keepalive timeout to reduce resets.
incident-bot: Incident annotated: mitigation action=scale_gateways, blacklist_backend, route_shift; status=mitigating; started=1795554322
Tom H: Observability: enabling debug traces for gateway->embeddings for 10m to capture handshake failures. Will share trace IDs.
Aisha (oncall): customer impact: intermittent 502/504 for model endpoints; synthetic checks still failing ~2% for a subset. We should prepare status page update if errors persist >30m.
Maya (support): queued status update draft, will publish after we confirm stabilization.
Priya R: metrics looking better: overall 5xx down to 1.4%. svc-embeddings-prod-2 still recovering but GCs subsided.
Jorge (edge): confirming no new keepalive resets in last 3m. Edge->gateway success rate trending up.
Tom H: leaving traces on for another 5m, then revert. recommend keeping canary shift at 50% until full health is green for 15m.
Aisha (oncall): agreed. continuing watch. assign postmortem to Tom H + Jorge + Priya. escalation to platform lead if recurrence.
Maya (support): status update posted: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1795554322 : "Mitigations applied. Service recovering. Investigating root cause."
Aisha (oncall): thanks all. I'll close pager when system stable for 30m. ping if anything spikes. :eyes:
Tom H: quick note for postmortem: investigate connection pool sizing, GC tuning on embeddings service, and possible routing backpressure at edge.
Priya R: will capture deploy/config diffs for last 24h. saving logs and traces to incident folder: s3://redwood-incidents/1795554322/
Jorge (edge): leaving a short checklist: (1) confirm backend memory pressure root cause, (2) validate circuit breaker thresholds, (3) improve edge fallback smoothing.
incident-bot: Pager resolved automatically: no active alerts for 12m. status=watching. closed=1795555344
